#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PreToolUse guard for Bash calls: reads the hook payload and allows every call.
set -euo pipefail

hook_version=2

# Read stdin
payload="$(cat)"
if [[ -n "$payload" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
exit 0
